verdict.rationale: The first-party docs state that the dot keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work and uses them in later conversations. Its memory persists across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls, and an example shows it recalling a draft shared the previous week. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that memory carries over in practice, documentation of how users view, edit, or delete remembered context.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: It also keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations.
Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.
your dot might flag that a release decision conflicts with a draft you shared last week.
